mapper.select: SELECT a.attend_id, a.student_id, a.attend_date, a.attend_status, a.note, a.reg_date, s.student_num, s.student_name, s.dept_name FROM TB_ATTEND a INNER JOIN TB_STUDENT s ON a.student_id = s.student_id WHERE a.attend_id = #{attendId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ATTEND ( student_id, attend_date, attend_status, note, reg_date ) VALUES ( #{studentId}, #{attendDate}, #{attendStatus}, #{note}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL( ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN attend_status IN ('출석','공결') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100 , 1) , 0) FROM TB_ATTEND WHERE attend_date = CURDATE()
